deviations_from_paper.explanation: Controlled lowercased whitespace-stripped GT 4-gram recall and exact GT string recovery are both 1.0. Internal line-level text-layer coverage is reported separately.
All 28 controlled pairs are concordant. The sparse two-page fixture additionally checks local headings/captions and includes a left/right swap negative control.

The basic ruled table matches 9/9 cells versus PyMuPDF 5/9. The advanced fixture also checks a two-page 6x3 logical table, two repeated header rows, a merged two-column header, cell bboxes, pipes and multiline text.
Line-level geometric marginalia leakage is 0 on both controlled and real demo documents. Mixed physical blocks are split with source_line_ids.
All 16 structure/formula/table/language/failure assertions and all four mutation-based negative controls pass.
Determinism, cache idempotency, exact-query provenance, source-prefixed merge, valid result acceptance, unknown-anchor rejection and missing-material failure all pass.

reference_value.rule: Median of three content-hash cache hits must be faster than median of three direct parses of the same controlled PDF.

deviations_from_paper.explanation: Scope is repeated-document efficiency only. First ingestion performs a full parse and is not claimed to be faster.

envelope.unit: quantitatively tested columns; three-column logic exists but is not in the measured envelope
logical table segments with up to two repeated header rows
absent(0)/present(1); absence is detected as unreadable

failure_modes.condition: image-only scanned page without a text layer
failure_modes.symptom: Zero text blocks and unreadable_pages=[1]; OCR remains necessary.

failure_modes.condition: password-encrypted PDF when empty-password authentication fails
failure_modes.symptom: Clear encryption error and CLI exit code 2; no fabricated text.
Clear cannot-open error and CLI failure rather than partial fabricated content.
No guessed tables; pdfplumber_unavailable warning is explicit.

failure_modes.condition: Symbol/Dingbats glyph with suspect ASCII mapping
failure_modes.symptom: Equation is marked needs_review; a Greek letter is not invented.

failure_modes.condition: vector figure without raster image block
failure_modes.symptom: A nearby Figure caption can reclassify a false table candidate as a vector-figure anchor; warning requires human review.
